title: LiquiFi Deal Boosts Coinbase Token Platform, Seeks to Simplify On-chain Vesting
body: Coinbase has acquired LiquiFi, a token management platform used by projects such as Uniswap Foundation, OP Labs (Optimism), Zora, and Ethena, for an undisclosed amount according to a blog post on July 2. Big news: We're acquiring @liquifi_finance , the leading token management platform for early-stage teams building onchain. Together we can support builders earlier in their journey, accelerating the path to economic freedom. pic.twitter.com/2rU9OYKxTe — Coinbase (@coinbase) July 2, 2025 Coinbase stated that the acquisition of LiquiFi enhances its ability to offer token cap table management, vesting, and compliance support, advancing its goal of becoming a comprehensive platform for launching and scaling on-chain businesses. LiquiFi is recognized for simplifying token ownership tracking, vesting schedules, and regulatory workflows. It has become a widely used tool among early-stage crypto teams seeking to streamline their token operations. With this integration, Coinbase seeks to address common challenges faced by builders, such as fragmented data management, legal uncertainty, and complex compliance requirements. LiquiFi automates these processes, allowing teams to operate more efficiently and with greater confidence. “Launching a token today is too hard,” said Greg Tusar, vice president of institutional product at Coinbase. “With LiquiFi, we’re lowering the barrier to entry and enabling innovation at speed.” Bringing End-to-End Support to the Token Economy According to Coinbase, LiquiFi’s technology will eventually be embedded within Coinbase Prime, improving its suite of services that already includes custody, trading, and financing. This vertical integration ensures that companies issuing tokens can do so in a secure, compliant, and user-friendly environment. The firm said its long-term vision is ambitious: making token launches easier, faster, and more global than issuing traditional startup equity. For founders, employees, and investors alike, Coinbase wants to create the default infrastructure for building and scaling tokenized businesses. Whether you’re launching a new protocol or managing employee token compensation, the tools to succeed will soon be in one place. Coinbase Named by TIME as a ‘Disruptor’ Recently, TIME has named Coinbase one of 2025’s 100 Most Influential Companies , pointing to the crypto exchange as a “disruptor” for its aggressive policy advocacy in Washington. The recognition follows a sharp 26% year-to-date surge in Coinbase’s stock, which climbed from around $303 to a high of $382 after the Senate passed the GENIUS stablecoin bill on June 17. TIME noted that Coinbase , which in May became the first crypto stock added to the S&P 500 index, is “a key driver of the industry’s policy efforts in Washington, D.C.” With more industry-friendly legislation on the horizon, the publication said Coinbase could cement its role as the central hub for U.S. crypto trading. Coinbase’s influence extends beyond the U.S. On June 20, the exchange secured a license to provide digital asset services across the European Union under the MiCA regulatory framework, granted by Luxembourg’s financial regulator. title: GBP/USD: UBS Unlocks Astonishing Upside Potential for the Pound
body: BitcoinWorld GBP/USD: UBS Unlocks Astonishing Upside Potential for the Pound In the fast-paced world of financial markets, where volatility often reigns supreme, both traditional assets and cryptocurrencies present unique opportunities and challenges. While digital assets capture significant attention, the foundational movements in the traditional forex market analysis continue to shape global economic landscapes. Today, we turn our gaze to a significant development in the currency world: the latest UBS outlook on the British Pound (GBP) against the US Dollar (USD). For investors and traders alike, understanding these shifts is paramount, as they can signal substantial shifts in capital flows and provide valuable insights for diversified portfolios. UBS, a global financial services giant, has recently revealed a notably optimistic stance on the GBP/USD pair, indicating further upside potential for the Pound. This positive assessment is not merely speculative; it is rooted in a detailed examination of economic fundamentals and market dynamics. Why UBS Sees Further Upside for GBP/USD? UBS’s positive sentiment regarding the GBP/USD pair stems from a confluence of factors, primarily focusing on economic divergences and policy expectations between the UK and the US. Their analysis suggests that the Sterling is poised for continued strength, moving beyond recent consolidation phases. The core of their argument revolves around the differing trajectories of inflation and monetary policy, alongside an improving economic outlook for the United Kingdom. Economic Resilience: The UK economy has shown surprising resilience, with key indicators suggesting a more robust performance than initially anticipated. This includes a resilient labor market and consumer spending, which underpin economic growth. Monetary Policy Divergence: A significant driver is the expected path of interest rates from the Bank of England (BoE) compared to the Federal Reserve (Fed). While the Fed might be nearing the end of its tightening cycle, or even contemplating cuts, the BoE is perceived to have more room for sustained higher rates, or at least a slower pace of easing, to combat persistent inflation. This differential in interest rate expectations makes the Pound more attractive to yield-seeking investors. Inflation Dynamics: Although inflation remains a challenge for both economies, the narrative around its trajectory and the central banks’ responses plays a crucial role. UBS likely anticipates that the UK’s inflation will prove stickier, necessitating a more hawkish stance from the BoE for longer, thereby supporting the Pound. Based on these fundamental drivers, UBS has reportedly set an ambitious target for the GBP/USD pair, projecting it to reach 1.32 over the next 6 to 12 months. This target reflects a strong conviction in the Pound’s underlying strength and the potential for the US Dollar to weaken as global economic conditions evolve. Unpacking the Pound Forecast: Key Drivers and Challenges To fully grasp the implications of this pound forecast , it is essential to delve deeper into the specific factors influencing Sterling’s trajectory and the potential headwinds it might face. The currency market is a complex interplay of macroeconomic data, geopolitical events, and market sentiment. Drivers of Pound Strength: UK Economic Data: Recent GDP figures, retail sales, and employment data have often surprised to the upside, painting a picture of an economy that is adapting to inflationary pressures better than some European counterparts. This resilience bolsters confidence in the UK’s economic outlook. Bank of England’s Stance: The BoE has consistently reiterated its commitment to bringing inflation back to target. Should inflation remain elevated, the market anticipates that the BoE will maintain a restrictive policy stance, offering continued support for the Pound through higher interest rate differentials. Global Risk Sentiment: As global economic uncertainty persists, the US Dollar often acts as a safe-haven currency. However, if global risk sentiment improves, or if other major economies show signs of recovery, the demand for the US Dollar could wane, indirectly benefiting currencies like the Pound. Potential Challenges for the Pound: Persistent Inflation: While a hawkish BoE supports the Pound, inflation that proves too stubborn could also stifle economic growth, leading to a stagflationary environment that would be detrimental to the currency. Global Economic Slowdown: A significant global recession could dampen demand for UK exports and impact investor confidence, regardless of domestic factors. Geopolitical Risks: Ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly in Europe, can introduce volatility and uncertainty, prompting a flight to safety that typically benefits the US Dollar. Political Stability: Domestic political developments in the UK can also influence investor sentiment and, consequently, the Pound’s performance. Navigating the Forex Market Analysis: Risks and Opportunities Understanding the broader forex market analysis is crucial for making informed decisions, especially when considering a specific currency pair like GBP/USD . While UBS presents an optimistic view, every market has its inherent risks and opportunities that traders and investors must consider. Here’s a breakdown of the key considerations: Aspect Potential Risks Potential Opportunities Economic Data Surprises Weaker-than-expected UK data could undermine confidence and trigger sell-offs. Stronger-than-expected UK data could fuel further Pound appreciation. Central Bank Policy Shifts A more dovish BoE or surprisingly hawkish Fed could reverse the trend. Continued BoE hawkishness and Fed dovishness would strengthen the Pound. Geopolitical Events Escalating conflicts or new global crises could trigger safe-haven flows to USD. De-escalation or stability could reduce demand for safe havens, benefiting GBP. Market Sentiment Sudden shifts in risk appetite or negative news could impact sentiment. Positive investor sentiment towards UK assets could drive inflows. It’s important for investors to conduct their own thorough due diligence and not rely solely on any single forecast, no matter how reputable the source. The market is dynamic, and conditions can change rapidly. Strategic Insights for Currency Trading: How to Approach GBP/USD For those engaged in currency trading , the UBS outlook provides a valuable framework, but successful execution requires strategic planning and disciplined risk management. Whether you are a seasoned trader or new to the forex markets, consider these actionable insights: Monitor Economic Calendars: Stay updated on key economic data releases from both the UK and the US, including inflation reports, GDP figures, employment statistics, and central bank speeches. These events are often catalysts for significant price movements in GBP/USD . Understand Technical Levels: While fundamentals drive long-term trends, technical analysis can help identify optimal entry and exit points. Look for key support and resistance levels, trendlines, and chart patterns that align with the bullish outlook. For instance, a break above a significant resistance level could confirm the upward momentum suggested by UBS. Manage Risk Prudentl y: Always define your risk tolerance before entering a trade. Use stop-loss orders to limit potential losses and take-profit orders to lock in gains. Even with a strong forecast, unexpected market reversals can occur. Consider Diversification: For investors with broader portfolios, a stronger Pound could impact the value of international assets or liabilities denominated in other currencies. Consider how a potential appreciation of GBP might affect your overall financial position. Stay Informed on Policy Shifts: Keep a close eye on the rhetoric and actions of the Bank of England and the Federal Reserve. Any unexpected shift in their monetary policy stance can have an immediate and profound impact on currency valuations. An example of a strategic approach might involve a long position on GBP/USD , targeting the 1.32 level, but with a strict stop-loss order placed below a recent support level (e.g., 1.25) to protect against adverse movements. This approach combines the fundamental conviction from the UBS outlook with practical risk management techniques essential for successful currency trading . What Does the UBS Outlook Mean for Investors? The positive UBS outlook for the Pound, particularly against the US Dollar, carries significant implications for a wide range of investors, from institutional funds to individual traders. It suggests a potential shift in the global currency landscape that warrants attention. For UK-Based Investors: A stronger Pound means that purchasing power abroad increases. For those holding foreign assets, their value in Sterling terms would decrease, necessitating a review of international investment strategies. For International Investors: The prospect of a strengthening Pound makes UK assets, such as equities and bonds, potentially more attractive, as returns could be enhanced by currency appreciation. This could lead to increased capital inflows into the UK. title: AUD/USD Forecast: Unlocking the Future of Australian Dollar with UBS’s Bold Projections
body: BitcoinWorld AUD/USD Forecast: Unlocking the Future of Australian Dollar with UBS’s Bold Projections Even in the fast-paced world of digital assets, understanding traditional financial markets like Forex can offer invaluable insights. For those keeping an eye on global economic shifts, a significant projection from UBS regarding the AUD/USD forecast is making waves. The Swiss banking giant has set a target of 0.70 for the Australian Dollar against the US Dollar by mid-2026, a move that could have profound implications for traders, investors, and anyone with exposure to global currencies. This isn’t just a number; it’s a reflection of anticipated economic shifts, policy decisions, and market dynamics that warrant a closer look. What factors are driving this optimistic outlook, and how might it reshape your understanding of the global financial landscape? Let’s dive deep into the nuances of this compelling projection. What Does UBS’s AUD/USD Forecast Truly Mean for Your Investments? When UBS, a major player in global finance, puts out an AUD/USD forecast targeting 0.70 by mid-2026, it signals a potential appreciation of the Australian Dollar against its US counterpart. Currently, the pair often hovers below this mark, so a move to 0.70 represents a notable upward trajectory. But what does this really signify for different market participants? For Traders: This forecast presents a potential long-term trading opportunity. Traders might look to establish long positions in AUD/USD, betting on its rise. However, it’s crucial to remember that a mid-2026 target means navigating short-term volatility and market noise. Patience and a robust risk management strategy will be paramount. For Investors: For those with investments denominated in Australian Dollars, a stronger AUD could mean increased purchasing power internationally. Conversely, for investors holding US Dollar-denominated assets, a rising AUD might impact the value of their holdings when converted back to AUD. It highlights the importance of currency hedging strategies for international portfolios. For Businesses: Australian exporters would find their goods more expensive for international buyers, potentially impacting competitiveness. Importers, however, would benefit from a stronger AUD, making foreign goods cheaper. Businesses with international revenue streams or costs need to consider these currency movements in their financial planning. For Individuals: Travelers planning trips to the US from Australia might find their money goes further. For Australians living abroad and earning in USD, converting back to AUD would yield less. Understanding these shifts can help individuals make informed decisions about remittances, savings, and international spending. The 0.70 target isn’t just a static point; it’s a reflection of a complex interplay of macroeconomic forces that UBS believes will align over the next few years to support the Australian Dollar’s strength. What’s Driving the UBS Currency Outlook Towards 0.70? UBS’s projection is not based on mere speculation; it’s rooted in a comprehensive analysis of various fundamental drivers. The UBS currency outlook for AUD/USD is influenced by several key macroeconomic themes. Let’s explore the primary factors underpinning this optimistic forecast: 1. Commodity Price Dynamics Australia is a major exporter of raw materials, particularly iron ore, coal, and liquefied natural gas (LNG). Global demand for these commodities significantly impacts Australia’s terms of trade and, consequently, the value of the Australian Dollar. UBS likely anticipates a sustained or even rising trend in key commodity prices, driven by: Global Economic Recovery: As major economies, especially China, continue to stabilize and grow, demand for industrial metals and energy resources tends to increase. Supply Constraints: Ongoing geopolitical events or production challenges in other major commodity-producing regions could keep prices elevated. Green Transition Minerals: Increasing demand for minerals essential for renewable energy technologies (e.g., copper, lithium) could provide additional support. 2. Interest Rate Differentials The relative interest rates between Australia and the United States play a crucial role. Higher interest rates typically attract foreign capital seeking better returns, thus strengthening a currency. UBS’s forecast suggests an expectation of: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Policy: The RBA might maintain a relatively hawkish stance or be slower to cut rates compared to the US Federal Reserve, or even embark on further hikes if inflation proves sticky. US Federal Reserve (Fed) Policy: UBS may anticipate the Fed to cut rates more aggressively or maintain lower rates for longer as inflation cools and economic growth moderates, narrowing the yield gap in favor of the AUD. 3. Global Growth and Risk Sentiment The Australian Dollar is often considered a ‘risk-on’ currency, meaning it tends to perform well when global economic sentiment is positive and investors are more willing to take on risk. A robust global growth environment, particularly a strong recovery in China (Australia’s largest trading partner), would bode well for the AUD. UBS’s outlook likely factors in: China’s Economic Performance: Sustained recovery and stimulus measures in China directly boost demand for Australian exports. Overall Risk Appetite: A reduction in geopolitical tensions and increased stability in global financial markets would encourage capital flows into riskier assets, including the AUD. 4. Terms of Trade Australia’s terms of trade, which measure the ratio of export prices to import prices, are a key determinant of national income and currency strength. If export prices rise relative to import prices, it improves the terms of trade, boosting national income and typically leading to a stronger Australian Dollar . UBS’s projection implies an improvement in these terms over the forecast period. These interconnected factors form the bedrock of the UBS currency outlook , painting a picture of an Australian economy poised for strength relative to its US counterpart over the medium term. How Will Key Factors Influence the Australian Dollar’s Journey? The journey of the Australian Dollar towards the 0.70 mark is not a straight line. It will be influenced by a dynamic interplay of domestic and international factors. Understanding these elements is crucial for anyone looking to navigate the Forex market. Let’s break down the key influencers and their potential impact: Domestic Factors: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Monetary Policy: The RBA’s decisions on interest rates are paramount. If the RBA maintains a tighter monetary policy than expected, or if inflation proves persistent, leading to further rate hikes, the AUD would likely strengthen. Conversely, earlier or deeper rate cuts would weigh on the currency. Australian Economic Data: Key indicators such as GDP growth, inflation figures (CPI), employment data, and retail sales provide insights into the health of the Australian economy. Stronger-than-expected data generally supports the AUD, as it signals a robust economy that might warrant tighter monetary policy. Government Policy and Fiscal Health: Government spending, taxation policies, and the overall fiscal position can impact investor confidence and, indirectly, the currency. A stable and responsible fiscal approach is generally positive for currency stability. International Factors: US Federal Reserve (Fed) Monetary Policy: The Fed’s actions on interest rates and quantitative easing/tightening are arguably the most significant external factor. If the Fed maintains higher rates for longer or hikes further, it makes the USD more attractive, potentially capping AUD/USD gains. If the Fed cuts rates aggressively, it could weaken the USD, providing tailwinds for the AUD. Global Economic Growth: As a commodity-linked currency, the AUD thrives on strong global growth, particularly from major trading partners like China. A slowdown in global growth or a recession in key economies would dampen demand for Australian exports and weigh on the AUD. Commodity Prices: Continued strength in prices for Australia’s key exports (iron ore, coal, LNG) is vital. Any significant downturn in these prices due to oversupply or weakening demand would directly impact the AUD’s value. Geopolitical Risks: Global instability, trade wars, or major conflicts can trigger a ‘flight to safety,’ often strengthening the US Dollar as a safe-haven asset, at the expense of riskier currencies like the AUD. Here’s a simplified table summarizing the potential impact of these factors: Factor Scenario Impact on AUD/USD RBA Interest Rates Higher than Fed Positive (AUD strengthens) US Fed Interest Rates Lower than RBA Positive (AUD strengthens) Commodity Prices Rising Positive (AUD strengthens) Global Growth (esp. China) Strong Positive (AUD strengthens) Australian Economic Data Strong Positive (AUD strengthens) Global Risk Sentiment ‘Risk-on’ (positive) Positive (AUD strengthens) Geopolitical Tensions Rising Negative (AUD weakens, USD strengthens) Monitoring these factors continuously will be key to understanding the Australian Dollar’s trajectory and the viability of UBS’s ambitious forecast. Ready to Trade? Applying Forex Market Analysis to Your Strategy For those considering positions based on UBS’s AUD/USD forecast , simply knowing the target isn’t enough. Successful trading requires a disciplined approach, integrating this long-term outlook with comprehensive Forex market analysis . Here’s how you can apply this information to your trading strategy: 1. Fundamental Analysis Alignment: UBS’s forecast is primarily based on fundamental factors. Your analysis should align with these drivers: Monitor Economic Calendars: Keep a close eye on economic releases from Australia (RBA meetings, CPI, employment) and the US (Fed meetings, NFP, CPI). Deviations from expectations can cause significant short-term volatility. Track Commodity Markets: Pay attention to the price movements of key Australian exports like iron ore. Strong commodity prices generally provide underlying support for the AUD. Assess Global Risk Appetite: Follow global news, geopolitical developments, and stock market performance. A positive global sentiment often correlates with a stronger AUD. 2. Technical Analysis for Entry and Exit Points: While fundamentals drive the long-term trend, technical analysis helps pinpoint optimal entry and exit points. Support and Resistance Levels: Identify key price levels where the AUD/USD pair has historically found buying or selling interest. These can act as potential turning points. Trend Indicators: Use moving averages, MACD, or RSI to confirm the prevailing trend and identify overbought/oversold conditions that might signal a temporary reversal. Chart Patterns: Look for bullish patterns (e.g., inverse head and shoulders, double bottoms) that could indicate an impending upward move, or bearish patterns that signal a correction. 3. Risk Management is Paramount: Even with a strong forecast, the Forex market is volatile. Protecting your capital is crucial. Position Sizing: Never risk more than a small percentage of your trading capital on a single trade (e.g., 1-2%). Stop-Loss Orders: Always use stop-loss orders to limit potential losses if the market moves against your position unexpectedly. Take-Profit Levels: While the 0.70 target is long-term, consider setting intermediate take-profit levels to lock in gains along the way. 4. Diversification and Correlation: Consider how AUD/USD moves in relation to other assets in your portfolio. The Australian Dollar often correlates with commodity prices and global equities. Understanding these correlations can help you diversify your risk and identify opportunities. Integrating robust Forex market analysis with UBS’s long-term projection provides a comprehensive framework for making informed trading decisions. Remember, the market is dynamic, and continuous monitoring is essential. Beyond the Forecast: Crafting Your Winning Currency Trading Strategy A forecast, even from a reputable institution like UBS, is a guide, not a guarantee. To truly capitalize on potential movements like the AUD/USD forecast , you need a well-defined and adaptable currency trading strategy . This involves more than just identifying a direction; it encompasses planning, execution, and continuous learning. 1. Define Your Time Horizon and Risk Tolerance: Long-Term Investor vs. Short-Term Trader: UBS’s mid-2026 target is for a longer-term horizon. If you’re a day trader, this forecast provides context but your strategy will focus on intraday volatility. For a swing trader or long-term investor, it offers a directional bias for larger positions. Comfort with Volatility: The path to 0.70 will likely be bumpy. How much volatility are you comfortable enduring? Your risk tolerance will dictate your position sizing and the tightness of your stop-loss orders. 2. Integrate Multiple Analytical Approaches: A robust strategy often combines different forms of analysis: Fundamental Analysis: As discussed, this provides the ‘why’ behind the move. Understand the economic narratives driving the AUD and USD. Technical Analysis: This provides the ‘when’ and ‘where.’ Use chart patterns, indicators, and support/resistance levels to identify entry and exit points, as well as confirm trends. Sentiment Analysis: Gauge market sentiment by observing news headlines, social media trends, and institutional positioning. Extreme sentiment can sometimes signal a reversal. 3. Develop a Trading Plan and Stick to It: A clear trading plan is the backbone of any successful currency trading strategy . Your plan should include: Entry Criteria: What specific conditions must be met before you enter a trade? Exit Criteria: When will you take profit? When will you cut losses? Risk Management Rules: How much capital will you risk per trade? What is your maximum daily/weekly loss? Trade Management: How will you manage the trade once it’s open (e.g., trailing stops, scaling in/out)? 4. Continuous Learning and Adaptation: The Forex market is constantly evolving. Your strategy should too. Regularly review your trades, analyze your successes and failures, and adapt your plan based on market conditions and new information. Economic forecasts, including the UBS currency outlook , can change, and your strategy must be flexible enough to adjust. 5. The Psychological Edge: Emotional discipline is often the most challenging aspect of trading. Fear of missing out (FOMO) or fear of losing can lead to poor decisions. Stick to your plan, avoid overtrading, and understand that losses are a part of the game. Crafting a winning currency trading strategy is an ongoing process of education, discipline, and adaptation. While UBS’s projection offers a valuable long-term perspective, your success will ultimately hinge on the robustness of your own trading framework and your ability to execute it consistently. Challenges and Risks to the UBS Forecast While UBS’s AUD/USD forecast presents an optimistic scenario, it’s crucial to acknowledge the inherent uncertainties and risks that could derail or alter this projection. No forecast is infallible, especially one stretching out to mid-2026. Here are some key challenges and risks: Unexpected Economic Shocks: A severe global recession, a major financial crisis, or unforeseen economic downturns in key regions (e.g., China, US) could significantly impact commodity demand and risk sentiment, weakening the AUD. Monetary Policy Divergence: If the RBA becomes unexpectedly dovish (e.g., due to a domestic economic slowdown) or the Fed becomes surprisingly hawkish (e.g., due to persistent inflation), the interest rate differential could move against the AUD, contrary to UBS’s presumed trajectory. Commodity Price Volatility: A sharp and sustained decline in the prices of Australia’s major exports (iron ore, coal) due to new supply, reduced demand, or technological shifts could severely undermine the Australian Dollar. Geopolitical Instability: Escalation of existing conflicts or emergence of new geopolitical tensions could trigger a strong flight to safe-haven assets, primarily the US Dollar, at the expense of ‘risk-on’ currencies like the AUD. Structural Changes: Long-term shifts in global trade patterns, supply chains, or energy consumption could impact Australia’s export profile and economic resilience, potentially affecting the AUD’s value. Data Surprises: Any significant deviation in key economic data points (inflation, employment, GDP) from market expectations in either Australia or the US could lead to sharp and sustained currency movements that challenge the forecast. These risks underscore the dynamic nature of Forex markets and the importance of continuous monitoring and adaptability in any trading or investment strategy. While a UBS currency outlook provides a valuable directional bias, it must be viewed within the context of these potential headwinds. Conclusion: Navigating the Future of AUD/USD UBS’s projection of the AUD/USD reaching 0.70 by mid-2026 offers a compelling long-term perspective for the Australian Dollar . This forecast is underpinned by expectations of favorable commodity prices, a narrowing interest rate differential, and a generally positive global economic environment. For traders and investors, this presents a potential opportunity, but it also highlights the necessity of thorough Forex market analysis and a disciplined currency trading strategy . The journey to 0.70 will undoubtedly be marked by volatility and influenced by a myriad of domestic and international factors, from central bank policies to geopolitical events. While the AUD/USD forecast from UBS provides a strong directional signal, success in navigating this landscape will depend on your ability to interpret market dynamics, manage risk effectively, and adapt your approach as new information emerges. title: Intel implements swift cost‑cutting initiatives
body: Since taking charge of Intel in March, new CEO Lip ‑Bu Tan has wasted no time tackling costs and hunting for fresh growth avenues at the struggling US chipmaker, including restructuring the business. By June, insiders say, he began to express doubts about the manufacturing process, nicknamed 18A, that his predecessor Pat Gelsinger had championed, warning it might not win over new customers. Now, the CEO wants to explore a huge shift in the contract manufacturing known as the “foundry” business. Intel implements swift cost‑cutting initiatives Tan’s first months saw him slice through what he viewed as bloated middle management and bring in new engineering talent, all in the name of putting Intel’s finances on a firmer footing. The urgency was clear: Intel hadn’t turned a profit since 1986, and its $18.8 billion net loss for 2024 was a stark reminder that bold action was needed. Sources familiar with the talks reveal that 18A, a cutting‑edge method including a novel transistor design and power‑delivery scheme, may be shelved for external sales. Developing 18A and its variant, 18A‑P, has already cost Intel billions . Halting its marketing would likely trigger a hefty write‑off, with analysts estimating hundreds of millions, if not billions, in losses. Yet the tech’s appeal seems to be waning just as rivals like TSMC press ahead with their N2 node. Intel declined to comment on what it called a rumor. “Lip-Bu and the executive team are committed to strengthening our roadmap, building trust with our customers, and improving our financial position for the future,” the company said in a statement “We have identified clear areas of focus and will take actions needed to turn the business around.” – Intel. Last year, Intel reported its first unprofitable year since 1986. Recently, the company was reportedly considering selling its networking and edge-computing operations known as NEX as part of the company’s broader strategy to focus on its more profitable businesses. The company is looking at an urgent appeal to customers With TSMC’s N2 on track and Apple and Nvidia among the biggest fabless clients out there, Tan’s strategy calls for redirecting resources to Intel’s next‑gen 14A process. He believes 14A could give the company a competitive edge, but only if major partners buy in. To that end, Tan has instructed his team to map out options for the board’s upcoming meeting, possibly as soon as this month. A final verdict on whether to stop pitching 18A externally may not come until the autumn session, given the high stakes and complexities involved. Even if the marketing of 18A is curtailed, Intel plans to keep using the process for in‑house designs and existing commitments. That means Panther Lake laptop chips, lauded as the most advanced processors ever made in the US, will still roll off its 18A line in late 2025. And Intel must honor contracts to produce chips for Amazon and Microsoft on the same node, given their tight deadlines. The broader picture remains unsettled. Hopes hinge on delivering 14A swiftly and tailoring it to marquee clients’ needs. If successful, Intel could reclaim ground lost to TSMC over the past two decades, especially in the booming realms of mobile computing and AI. But slippage in 14A development or an unfavorable board decision might prompt the company to stick with 18A’s original roadmap. Tan’s deliberations underscore the huge risks and investments required to revive Intel’s foundry ambitions. As the board weighs his proposals, the chip world watches closely – a course correction now could shape the future of American semiconductor manufacturing for years to come, as well as the company’s profitability. Game-Changing Presentation Robinhood just shook markets with a set of new initiatives and projects that could help supercharge its revenues. Tokenized U.S. Stocks & ETFs in Europe Robinhood will now be offering over 200 tokenized stocks and ETFs, which will be available in Europe and will trade 24/5. These tokenized shares will be hosted on the Arbitrum blockchain. Each token is representative of a real share, with all of the traditional benefits, but also more flexibility, ease of trade, and lower fees. Broader Crypto Products Crypto futures and trading will soon be available in Europe , and in the US, the company is re-launching Ethereum and Solana staking. More interestingly, Robinhood is also working on its own L2 blockchain, which it will use in the future to tokenize more real-world assets. New Fintech Tools We’re also getting Robinhood Cortex, Strategies , and more banking services. Another move that solidifies Robinhood’s position as a go-to financial service provider, beyond simple stock trading, and the company also launched its prediction market hub back in March. So Much Growth Potential There are a lot of interesting markets opening up to Robinhood thanks to these new developments. European Market The European retail market could be a strong growth area, since it is underserved, especially in terms of giving access to U.S. securities. Retail trade Volumes (BMLL) The U.S. retail market is, in fact, 20x bigger than the European one, which only sees around $12-$14 billion in trading on a monthly basis. Nonetheless, the opportunity here to disrupt is big, and it’s especially appealing as we’ve seen European markets begin to outperform and the USD continues to decline. Prediction Market The prediction hub opens up Robinhood to potentially also becoming a large player in the sports betting industry, which could be worth over $235 billion by 2025 . And it doesn’t stop there. As the blockchain-enabled Polymarket has shown, now worth over $1 billion , there’s plenty of appetite for all sorts of money to be made from prediction betting beyond sporting events. Banking and Stablecoins The move into banking has been underway for a while, with the Robinhood Gold card launched back in March 2024. Now, HOOD is expanding its portfolio of products, and it’s also dipping its toes into the exciting world of stablecoins. Partnering with Kraken , Robinhood has launched its own USD stablecoin, USDG. As I wrote about recently, some studies suggest that 10% of the circulation money supply could eventually take the form of stablecoins . The Kraken and Robinhood partnership could actually be a real contender to stablecoin dominance thanks to its combined presence in the crypto and investing space. The Future Is On Chain Robinhood is building its own L2 blockchain, and this is the foundation of everything that is supporting Robinhood's growth story right now. Blockchain technology is ultimately what will allow for the seamless tokenization of real-world assets, improved banking and payment infrastructure, and lay the foundation for stablecoins. The fact that Robinhood is already having the foresight to build its L2 rather than rely on existing infrastructure is very, very good news. Owning the infrastructure on which all these future developments will take place could turn out to be very profitable. For context, the Ethereum blockchain generated almost $7.3 billion in revenues in the last year. This is another very exciting area for Robinhood, and it has the momentum and appeal to young investors necessary to actually become a player in the space. Potential Risks While I think Robinhood is doing very well, there are plenty of potential risks. Tokenization, especially, will face regulatory headwinds. The financial sector is deeply entrenched, and big players won’t allow Robinhood to just take all their market. They will either lobby for regulatory hurdles or quickly try to catch up to what Robinhood is doing. On the other hand, the valuation for Robinhood is getting quite rich, even if we do take into account future earnings growth. HOOD valuation (SA) PE of 45, trading at over 70 times cash flow and nearly 6x forward PEG. Robinhood is expensive even by today’s standards, but it may be justified for a dominant player in such an exciting space. Final Thoughts All in all, I see Robinhood as a long-term play and would advise holding the stock as all of these disruptions and innovations unfold. Most of all, Robinhood’s leadership and management have shown they are very much on the ball when it comes to pursuing the next big thing, and that’s very encouraging.

title: Scaramucci Says Bitcoin Treasury Trend Will Fade Despite Saylor’s Success
body: Anthony Scaramucci, the founder and managing partner of hedge fund SkyBridge Capital, says the wave of companies adopting a bitcoin (BTC) treasury strategy is just a passing trend. In an interview with Bloomberg, Scaramucci said he expects the approach to lose momentum in the coming months. “Right now we’re having this replicative treasury company idea,” Scaramucci said. “So, you know, it will fade.” He implied that investors may start to wonder why they’re paying extra for a company to hold an asset they could simply buy themselves. The idea of using bitcoin as a corporate treasury asset gained traction in 2021, when Strategy (MSTR), a software developer led by Michael Saylor, became the first major public company to do so. Saylor’s aggressive bitcoin purchases turned Strategy into a de facto bitcoin investment vehicle, sending its stock price soaring nearly 3,000% since then. The massive gains drew attention across corporate America and elsewhere. A number of companies followed Strategy’s lead, including medical device maker Semler Scientific (SMLR), which announced its own bitcoin treasury strategy in May 2024, and Tokyo-based Metaplanet (3350), which started out as a hotel management company. The trend hasn’t been limited to high-profile firms. Smaller companies, often penny-stocks, also jumped in, trying to raise capital or attract investor interest by adding bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies to their balance sheets. What began as a focus on bitcoin soon expanded to other digital assets. Some companies opted to purchase ether (ETH) or XRP (XRP) as part of their treasury strategy, pushing the concept beyond its original scope. Scaramucci acknowledged that Saylor’s success is unique, pointing to the company’s other business lines beyond bitcoin holdings. “Saylor’s case is different, because he’s got a couple different products going now,” Scaramucci said in the interview with Bloomberg. “I’m not negative on the others, because I’m too bullish on bitcoin, but I would just say as an investor, you have to look through the underlying costs associated with each one of these treasury companies.”

The rising interest is partly due to clearer regulations in the U.S., which has encouraged major financial players to invest in Bitcoin instead of smaller cryptocurrencies. title: MARA Holdings: Levered To Post-Halving Bitcoin Cycle
body: Summary We initiate coverage on MARA Holdings with a Strong Buy and $44 price target, citing unmatched operational leverage to Bitcoin’s next cycle and cost leadership. Our thesis is built on above-consensus revenue forecasts, driven by a 60 EH/s hash-rate ramp, low $0.04/kWh energy costs, and robust treasury BTC optionality. Valuation is compelling: MARA trades at a deep discount to historical and peer multiples, with 180% upside justified by macro tailwinds and post-halving expansion. Key risks include Bitcoin price volatility, regulatory headwinds, and potential dilution, but we see the risk/reward as highly favorable at current levels. Levered to the Next Crypto Cycle We initiate with a Strong Buy/$44 PT. MARA Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MARA ) operates one of the world’s most advanced vertically integrated Bitcoin mining platforms, leveraging proprietary technology and low-cost energy infrastructure to deliver digital assets at scale via the US. Beneath the volatile exterior, MARA occupies a sweet spot of structural and cyclical drivers for a step-change in miner economics. More than 100k BTC cleared in the second quarter of 2025 began to reset base-case assumptions, yet consensus underwrites sub-80k BTC and underestimates the length and magnitude of post-halving multiple expansion. We see $1.36 billion in FY 2025E revenue (up 107% y/y, 43% above the Street) as energized Ohio/Texas wind assets, along with forthcoming flare-gas sites, deliver 60 EH/s of hash rate to keep network share elevated despite global difficulty hikes. Embedded in our base case is a self-inflicted above-consensus BTC price path of $105 k/$130 k FY 2025E/FY 2026E annual averages, already realized in spot markets and amplified by MARA’s ops edge: $0.04/kWh energy costs and superior fee per transaction capture, driving 12% outperformance in BTC-denominated revenue. Our valuation embeds a blended FY 2026E P/S of 10.5x, balancing against downside the visibility of its treasury assets and factoring in the concentrated potency of macro tailwinds: (i) a window to imminent Fed easing, (ii) record spot ETF inflows and (iii) the historic miner inflection 12–18 months post-halving. Regulatory overhang and bouts of network hash growth present headline risk to our thesis, but cost structures and balance sheet optionality leave more than enough margin for error. At 180% upside to our PT and trading up short of its historical median multiple, we see R/R as simply too skewed. Maximizing Miner Economics Marathon Digital Holdings exemplifies scale-driven cost leadership in BTC mining. Energized hash rate grew 95% y/y to 54.3 EH/s, capturing over 2x network share, driven by vertical integration and diversified energy inputs with 139 MW of self-generated wind, flare-gas, and data center power. Electric cost per BTC is now $35,728, and Marathon has delivered record 4 quarter-over-quarter hash-cost improvements. The blend of BtM wind and off-grid gas should lower all-in power costs to $10/MW for key ARPs, a breakpoint few peers can reach. This configuration supports an IRR of 30–40% under muted hash-price assumptions. As investors toggle between exahash headlines and transient efficiency gains, Marathon’s scale-plus-cost flywheel stands out as a sustainable platform—combining energized capacity, asset flexibility, power origination optionality, and proprietary ASIC integration—to preserve sector-leading share through mining-cycle volatility. Q1 Earnings Presentation Treasury Arbitrage Strategy embedded optionality. Fundamentally, we think the market has mispriced the strategic merit of MARA’s BTC on balance sheet, both in current balance sheet positioning and in embedded optionality. The 49,375 BTC on treasury ($5.42bn equivalent) offers investors direct participation in digital asset appreciation while buying an operating platform that can generate $852mn of annualized BTC back into the treasury at current network economics. Such a magnitude of treasury represents a uniquely powerful downside hedge versus global mining peers, allowing valuation capital preservation through deep crypto drawdowns and giving management optionality to monetize at cycle highs or deploy collateral opportunistically. Trading at $16.52, implied per-share BTC value stands at $15.41/share, providing the operating business just above $1/share after adjusting for net cash and PP&E. The disconnect continues to widen as MARA’s proven BTC accumulation cadence (950 BTC in a single month, or $104.5mn at $110,000 spot) captures robust upside and offers a meaningful premium to direct mining costs on the books. We believe consensus underappreciates the downside compounding and the asymmetry of MARA’s treasury, which ultimately provides shareholders a volatility buffer and an asymmetric payoff should direct adoption and institutional allocation run further. Case scenarios illustrate that the BTC is over-collateralizing the equity to such a degree that it meaningfully caps downside. We view MARA trading as a rare hybrid asset in which meaningful core value effectively underwrites investor participation in the next mining-led BTC upcycle. Q1 Earnings Presentation Materially Above-Consensus Revenue Outlook We model MARA’s FY 2025E and FY 2026E crypto revenues at $1.36bn (107% y/y) and $1.44bn, respectively, vs. the Street consensus of $948mn, placing us 43% and 32% above the Street based on structural tailwinds we believe the Street underappreciates: 1) Ambitious hash rate ramp to 60 EH/s as Ohio, TX wind and other flare-gas sites fully energize, positioning MARA for sustained 5% network share as difficulty resumes a persistent upward trend; 2) Explicit BTC pricing assumptions of $105k in FY 2025E and $130k in FY 2026E vs. consensus sub-$80k, already clearing $100k in the second quarter of 2025; 3) Proportional transaction-fee capture via MARA pool’s >10% outperformance vs. network average and 100% fee retention, translating to 12% higher BTC-denominated revenues. We acknowledge risk of sharp network hash rate acceleration beyond guidance or, less likely, regulatory change, but with visibility into energized capacity, a unique cost profile via $10/MWh ARP sites, and institutional BTC demand, we see the Street as significantly too conservative. Valuation Our $44 PT for MARA is based on a FY 2026E P/S multiple of 10.5x applied to our above-consensus revenue forecast of $1.44bn, yielding an implied 180% upside. The premium multiple is fully justified by outsized revenue growth acceleration powered by a ramped-up 60 EH/s hash-rate and a low $0.04/kWh power edge, plus Bitcoin treasury visibility that effectively limits downside. Company Data, FMP, Moretus Research Our 10.5x multiple aligns with the company’s historical median and stands to benefit from macro tailwinds of Federal Reserve easing and surging institutional ETF flows, which could prime post-halving multiple expansion. MARA trades at 7.7x P/S, below its historical norm (27th percentile) and below peer multiples (5.8x P/S; 17th percentile), despite margin resiliency and a market-leading +5.9% year-over-year revenue growth into FY 2026E. We believe Street assumptions on Bitcoin price and network share are overly conservative, and MARA warrants re-rating for its operational leverage. Risks to Our Strong Buy Thesis Our bullish thesis on Marathon Digital Holdings, Inc. ( MARA ) is supported by favorable capacity growth, low-cost operations, and a structurally higher post-halving Bitcoin price deck. Key risks include MARA’s operational and valuation leverage to Bitcoin’s price: a sustained pullback below $90,000 or an acceleration in network-wide difficulty could compress margins and force operational retrenchment, given energy costs could rise to $70K per Bitcoin if difficulty increases or electricity prices exceed model assumptions. Regulatory uncertainty poses another risk: state and federal energy restrictions, new environmental mandates, or regional off-grid mining clampdowns could raise compliance costs or force site curtailments, threatening hash-rate growth and undermining our above-consensus FY 2025E–FY 2026E estimates. Finally, MARA’s strategic use of ATM equity issuance could result in dilution and dampen our anticipated multiple re-rating if the Bitcoin market softens or policy risks intensify. Investors should monitor Bitcoin network hash-rate, MARA’s realized electricity costs, and state and federal regulatory developments as potential downside triggers. Conclusion We reiterate our Strong Buy on Marathon Digital Holdings, Inc. based on MARA's peer-best operational leverage to BTC's next cycle and differentiated cost structure leading to best-in-class risk-adjusted return in the public minter space. Consensus fundamentally underestimates the scale of MARA's hash-rate ramp and true macro tailwinds (institution ETF flows and post-halving multiple expansion) offering a clear path for outsized revenue / multiple re-rating, in our view. Investors should look through the short-term FOMO cycle and simply focus on execution against energized capacity, accumulating now as multiples are structurally depressed despite structural catalysts remaining fully intact.

title: Norway-Based Giant Mining Company Adds a New One to Its Bitcoin Investments! Here Are the Details
body: Norway-based deep-sea mining and sustainable mineral extraction company Green Minerals AS has announced that it has signed a structured financing agreement worth 250 million Norwegian crowns (approximately $23 million) with global investment group LDA Capital to support its Bitcoin treasury strategy. Green Minerals Signs 250 Million NOK Financing Deal to Grow Bitcoin Treasury According to the company, under this 12-month agreement, LDA Capital has granted Green Minerals an ATM (At-the-Market) share issuance option, which will allow the company to flexibly issue new shares depending on market conditions. This structure aims to both protect investor value and prevent unnecessary shareholding dilution. In addition, LDA Capital will have the right to purchase up to 1% of Green Minerals’ shares at a price of NOK 6.95 per share. This call option will be valid for 12 months. “In volatile market conditions, flexibility and sustainability are key factors. This financing model offers us strategic leeway in our goal of increasing our shares per Bitcoin ratio,” said Green Minerals Chairman Ståle Rodahl. LDA Capital has completed over $11 billion in traditional financing and $400 million in Web3 investments to date. This partnership with Green Minerals is a reflection of the flexible financing structures it has developed specifically for companies adopting digital asset treasury strategies. “We are pleased to support Green Minerals’ sustainable value creation strategy across digital assets and natural resources. This collaboration demonstrates LDA’s commitment to innovative opportunities,” said Warren Baker, Founding Partner of LDA Capital. Green Minerals said it will only disburse the funding in installments under favorable market conditions and will decide the timing and amount of each disbursement at its sole discretion. The company stated that it will inform the public if there are additional financing agreements in the future. *This is not investment advice. title: USD CHF Forecast: UBS Unveils Crucial Long-Term Prediction Below 0.80
body: BitcoinWorld USD CHF Forecast: UBS Unveils Crucial Long-Term Prediction Below 0.80 The world of finance is constantly abuzz with predictions, but few capture attention quite like a bold currency forecast from a major financial institution. For those navigating the volatile waters of cryptocurrency, understanding broader macroeconomic trends, especially in the forex market analysis , is crucial. This is where the recent USD CHF forecast from UBS comes into play, offering a compelling long-term perspective that could signal significant shifts in global currency dynamics. UBS, a leading global wealth manager, has issued a noteworthy prediction: they expect the USD/CHF pair to trade firmly below 0.80 in the long term. This isn’t just a fleeting daily fluctuation; it’s a strategic long-term call that suggests a profound strengthening of the Swiss Franc against the US Dollar. For investors and traders, this UBS currency prediction offers a glimpse into potential future economic landscapes and challenges the conventional wisdom about currency stability. What drives such a confident outlook, and what implications does it hold for the broader financial ecosystem? Understanding the UBS Currency Prediction : What Does Below 0.80 Mean? When we talk about the USD/CHF pair, we’re referring to how many Swiss Francs (CHF) one US Dollar (USD) can buy. A move below 0.80 signifies that it would take less than 0.80 Swiss Francs to purchase one US Dollar. In simpler terms, the Swiss Franc would become significantly stronger relative to the US Dollar. Historically, the USD/CHF has seen periods of both appreciation and depreciation, but a sustained level below 0.80 would represent a remarkable shift, echoing levels not consistently seen in decades. This UBS currency prediction isn’t just a number; it reflects a deep dive into fundamental economic factors. UBS’s analysts are likely weighing several key elements: Interest Rate Differentials: The policies of the Swiss National Bank (SNB) versus the Federal Reserve (Fed) play a pivotal role. If the SNB maintains a tighter monetary policy or raises rates more aggressively than the Fed, it makes holding Swiss Francs more attractive. Economic Stability and Growth: Switzerland’s reputation for economic stability, low inflation, and a strong current account surplus often bolsters the Franc. Global Risk Appetite: In times of global uncertainty, the Swiss Franc traditionally acts as a safe haven currency , attracting capital inflows. Let’s consider a simplified comparison of potential scenarios: Factor Scenario A: Strong CHF (Below 0.80) Scenario B: Weaker CHF (Above 0.90) SNB Policy Hawkish, potentially higher rates than Fed Dovish, lower rates than Fed Global Economy High uncertainty, risk aversion Strong growth, risk-on sentiment Switzerland’s Economy Robust growth, low inflation, large surplus Stagnant, higher inflation, trade deficit Investor Sentiment Flight to safety, capital inflows to CHF Search for yield, capital outflows from CHF Driving Forces Behind the Strong Swiss Franc Outlook The Swiss Franc has long been revered for its stability, a reputation earned through a combination of prudent monetary policy, a robust economy, and its traditional role as a safe haven. The current Swiss Franc outlook , as seen by UBS, is bolstered by several ongoing trends: The SNB’s Inflation Fight: The Swiss National Bank has been proactive in combating inflation, often leading to higher interest rates compared to some other major economies. This makes CHF-denominated assets more appealing to international investors seeking yield. Persistent Current Account Surplus: Switzerland consistently runs a large current account surplus, meaning it exports more goods and services than it imports, and receives significant income from foreign investments. This constant inflow of foreign currency strengthens demand for the Franc. Geopolitical Uncertainties: In a world grappling with geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, and economic slowdowns, the demand for reliable assets surges. The Swiss Franc, alongside gold and certain government bonds, often benefits from this “flight to quality.” Fiscal Discipline: Switzerland maintains a high degree of fiscal discipline, with low government debt relative to GDP, further enhancing its appeal as a stable investment destination. These factors collectively contribute to a powerful narrative for the Franc’s long-term appreciation, supporting the USD CHF forecast . The SNB’s willingness to intervene in currency markets, when necessary, also adds a layer of confidence for investors, signaling their commitment to price stability and managing the Franc’s value. The US Dollar’s Trajectory in the Context of Forex Market Analysis While the Swiss Franc’s strength is a significant part of the equation, the other side of the USD/CHF pair is the US Dollar. UBS’s long-term forecast implies a relative weakening of the Greenback against the Franc. This isn’t necessarily a blanket bearish view on the USD but rather a specific expectation within the context of this currency pair. In broader forex market analysis , the US Dollar’s trajectory is influenced by a multitude of factors: Federal Reserve Policy: The Fed’s stance on interest rates, quantitative easing, and inflation targeting profoundly impacts the Dollar. If the Fed pivots to a more dovish stance, or if inflation proves more stubborn than anticipated, it could erode the Dollar’s purchasing power. US Economic Performance: While the US economy is large and dynamic, concerns about slowing growth, potential recession, or high national debt could weigh on the Dollar. Global Reserve Currency Status: Despite challenges, the US Dollar remains the world’s primary reserve currency. However, discussions about de-dollarization or the rise of alternative currencies could, over the very long term, subtly shift demand. It’s important to remember that currency markets are relative. The UBS currency prediction for USD/CHF below 0.80 suggests that the factors supporting the Franc’s strength are expected to outweigh those supporting the Dollar, or that the Dollar’s challenges will be more pronounced relative to the Franc’s resilience. Is the Swiss Franc Still the Ultimate Safe Haven Currency ? The concept of a “safe haven” currency is fundamental to understanding the Swiss Franc’s appeal. In times of economic and political turmoil, investors typically flock to assets perceived as stable and secure. For decades, the Swiss Franc has epitomized this role. But is it still the ultimate safe haven currency in today’s complex global landscape? While some argue that its safe-haven status has been challenged by factors like the SNB’s past interventions to curb its appreciation, or by the rise of other perceived safe assets like gold or even certain digital assets, the core attributes remain: Political Neutrality: Switzerland’s long-standing political neutrality and stable democratic institutions provide a bedrock of confidence. Strong Legal Framework: A robust and transparent legal system protects property rights and fosters investor confidence. Sound Financial System: Switzerland’s banking sector is well-regulated and boasts a reputation for stability and confidentiality. Low Public Debt: Compared to many developed nations, Switzerland’s public debt levels are commendably low, reducing sovereign risk. These enduring qualities suggest that even if its safe-haven appeal is occasionally tested, the Franc’s fundamental role as a reliable store of value persists. This underlying strength is a key pillar supporting UBS’s confident USD CHF forecast . Navigating the USD CHF Forecast : Actionable Insights for Investors For investors, particularly those with exposure to global markets or even cryptocurrencies (which often react to broader macro trends), UBS’s long-term USD CHF forecast presents several actionable insights. While specific financial advice should always come from a qualified professional, here are some considerations: Diversification: A stronger Swiss Franc could impact portfolios with significant US Dollar exposure. Consider diversification strategies that account for potential currency shifts. Export/Import Implications: Businesses engaged in international trade between the US and Switzerland (or other Franc-pegged economies) should assess the impact of a stronger CHF on their cost structures and revenue. Swiss exports become more expensive, while US exports to Switzerland become cheaper. Interest Rate Arbitrage: While not for every investor, a sustained interest rate differential favoring the CHF could present opportunities for carry trades, though these come with their own risks. Macroeconomic Sensitivity: Understand that currency movements are often bellwethers for broader economic health. A strong CHF could signal ongoing global uncertainties or specific strengths within the Swiss economy. Risk Management: For forex traders, this forecast highlights the importance of robust risk management strategies, including stop-loss orders and position sizing, especially when trading against a strong long-term trend. It’s crucial to remember that long-term forecasts, while based on sound analysis, are not guarantees. Geopolitical events, unexpected central bank pivots, or unforeseen economic shocks could alter the trajectory. Therefore, continuous monitoring of global economic indicators and central bank communications is essential. Challenges and Counter-Arguments to the Bold Prediction While UBS’s UBS currency prediction is compelling, no forecast is without its potential challenges or counter-arguments. What could derail the USD/CHF from trading firmly below 0.80? SNB Intervention: Historically, the SNB has intervened in currency markets to prevent excessive appreciation of the Franc, which can harm Swiss exporters. While their focus has shifted to inflation, a rapid, significant appreciation might still trigger a response. Global Economic Rebound: A stronger-than-expected global economic recovery could reduce the demand for safe-haven assets, potentially weakening the Franc. US Dollar Resilience: The US Dollar’s status as the world’s primary reserve currency and its deep, liquid markets give it inherent resilience. Unexpected US economic strength or aggressive Fed tightening could strengthen the USD. Geopolitical Shifts: While uncertainty generally helps the CHF, certain geopolitical events could paradoxically lead to a flight to the USD, especially if the US is perceived as the ultimate safe haven in extreme crises. These potential headwinds underscore the dynamic nature of forex market analysis and the need for investors to remain agile and informed. Concluding Thoughts: A Long-Term Vision for Currency Markets UBS’s long-term USD CHF forecast , predicting the pair firmly below 0.80, represents a significant and confident call on the future of two major global currencies. It highlights the enduring strength of the Swiss Franc, driven by its sound economic fundamentals, prudent monetary policy, and its role as a premier safe haven currency . Conversely, it implies a relative softening of the US Dollar’s position against the Franc, influenced by differing central bank trajectories and economic outlooks. This UBS currency prediction offers more than just a number; it provides a framework for understanding the intricate interplay of global macroeconomics, central bank actions, and investor sentiment. For anyone involved in global finance, from institutional investors to individual traders, comprehending such long-term outlooks is vital for strategic planning and risk management. As the financial world continues to evolve, keeping an eye on these expert forecasts can offer invaluable guidance in navigating the complexities of the forex market analysis . To learn more about the latest Forex market trends, explore our article on key developments shaping the Swiss Franc and US Dollar liquidity. title: Opera’s Celo-Based MiniPay Wallet Launches Global-to-Local Stablecoin Payments with Noah
body: Celo -based MiniPay stablecoin wallet from Opera has partnered with payment infrastructure provider Noah to provide a non-custodial solution for global-to-local stablecoin payments. The announcement shared with Cryptonews argues that, while mainstream now, stablecoins still offer “a fragmented and inaccessible” experience. MiniPay’s and Noah’s partnership provides a fully non-custodial stablecoin payment feature that connects global banking rails with local payment methods, it claims. Users can utilize this solution to receive, convert, and spend stablecoins via global and local rails within the same app. They retain full control of their funds and transact globally without intermediaries, the announcement claims. Just announced @EthCC and coming soon to MiniPay: Virtual USD & EUR Accounts – receive via ACH/SEPA, powered by @Noah_HQ Pay with MiniPay to local payment methods Real stablecoin utility. Built-in. No friction. pic.twitter.com/fovTFq7iQv — MiniPay (@minipay) July 2, 2025 More precisely, “soon,” users will be able to create virtual USD and EUR accounts in order to get payments from family, clients, or employees via ACH (Automated Clearing House) and SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area). The funds will be automatically converted into USDT , USDC , or cUSD in the MiniPay wallet. Then, users can either spend the funds as stablecoins or withdraw them in a local currency. Moreover, the teams argue that this novel feature addresses a need specifically among freelancers in Africa and Latin America, as well as migrant workers sending and teams situated in different locations. It meets these needs by removing barriers, such as high fees and requiring foreign bank accounts. “It also represents a turning point,” the announcement says. “For the first time, users can receive USD or EUR via traditional banking rails and use these funds through stablecoins without needing custodians, exchanges, or third-party apps.” “This is a category-defining moment,” argues Noah CEO and Founder Shah Ramezani. “Together with MiniPay, we’re offering users global earnings with local access – no intermediaries, no delays, no friction.” You may also like: Opera’s MiniPay Wallet Integrates With Binance Connect MiniPay, Opera’s self-custodial stablecoin wallet built on Celo, has announced integration with Binance Connect, the official fiat-to-crypto gateway by crypto exchange Binance.According to the press release shared with Cryptonews, the new integration enables fiat on-ramps, expands payment options for users globally, and boosts accessibility to digital assets.Opera argues that a massive challenge in Web3 adoption is converting local currency into digital assets, quickly, securely, and... Spending Stablecoins Via Familiar Local Rails The announcement explains that local payment methods dominate many regions globally. Therefore, MiniPay wallet and Noah provide a way for users to receive international payments in stablecoins and spend using these familiar payment methods, the two say. Moreover, MiniPay has over 8 million activated wallets, 200 million processed transactions, and it’s available in over 50 countries. However, the new functionality extends users’ ability to send payments to over 70 destinations. This happens through local rails like M-Pesa in Kenya, Pix in Brazil, and bank transfers in Nigeria. Global-to-local stablecoin payments are coming to @minipay , powered by @Noah_HQ . – Receive USD and EUR via ACH/SEPA – Instant stablecoin conversion – Spend locally with M-Pesa, Pix, and more All inside MiniPay. Read more and join the waitlist: https://t.co/TQwFcQkUiU — Noah – Set money free (@Noah_HQ) July 2, 2025 Noah, fully compliant in over 70 countries, brings to the table an API that connects fiat and crypto payment flows across Latin America, Africa, and Asia. Therefore, the partnership between the two teams does away with obstacles to adoption and enables the MiniPay balance to be useful locally and natively, with everything happening within the MiniPay wallet. “This announcement isn’t about payments in theory, but about global earnings and local spend in practice,” said Murray Spark, Head of Ecosystem and Commercial at MiniPay. “By combining global rails like ACH with local payment methods like M-Pesa, all within MiniPay’s simple, non-custodial wallet, we’re unlocking stablecoin utility for everyday users.” You may also like: Celo-Based MiniPay Stablecoin Wallet Now Live on iOS and Android Stablecoin wallet MiniPay is now available as a standalone application on iOS and Android, available to users in over 50 countries.MiniPay is a lightweight, non-custodial stablecoin wallet built on Celo’s mobile-first Ethereum Layer-2 blockchain network and developed by Opera company Blueboard Limited.According to the press release, MiniPay enables users to send funds globally without complexities, as if sending an email or a text.Users can sign up using their phone number and a... title: JPMorgan’s Blockchain Unit Unveils Record-Breaking Carbon Credit Tokenization Pilot—What’s Next?
body: JPMorgan Chase is testing a new blockchain-based platform for carbon credits through its digital assets arm, Kinexys. The pilot is being developed in collaboration with S&P Global Commodity Insights, EcoRegistry, and the International Carbon Registry, according to Bloomberg report. The project will tokenize carbon credits listed in registry systems managed by the three partners. @SPGCI in Exploratory Testing w/ @jpmorgan : S&P Global’s Environmental Registry and #Kinexys by J.P. Morgan explore benefits of #Blockchain in #Carbon Markets. See: https://t.co/WWAMNkMPDv pic.twitter.com/W4EfBvYrnS — S&P Global Commodity Insights (@SPGCI) July 2, 2025 The goal is to see if blockchain technology can improve how carbon credits are tracked and transferred, from issuance to retirement. JPMorgan Partners With S&P, EcoRegistry for Carbon Credit Tokenization Pilot JPMorgan said in a statement that carbon markets continue to face issues like inefficiencies, fragmentation, and a lack of transparency. By using tokenization , the bank believes it can create a unified system where carbon credits move more easily between buyers and sellers. “The voluntary carbon market is ripe for innovation,” said Alastair Northway, head of natural resource advisory at JPMorgan Payments. “Tokenization could support development of a globally interoperable system that adds confidence into the integrity of the underlying infrastructure.” The tokenized version of a carbon credit would represent one ton of carbon dioxide either removed from or not released into the atmosphere. These offsets are typically generated through renewable energy or forest conservation projects. The initiative comes as Wall Street institutions increasingly experiment with tokenization. Firms like BlackRock and Deutsche Bank have also explored the use of digital tokens to represent real-world assets like stocks and treasuries, aiming to make trading faster and more efficient. In a report released the same day, JPMorgan described carbon as an asset class that could mature with stronger infrastructure and further innovation. But the bank also warned that without progress, there is a risk that trust in the carbon market could decline further. “In the past two years, the market has contracted and then stagnated,” the report stated. The carbon offset market has drawn both interest and criticism. While some see it as a way to direct money into climate solutions and emerging economies, others have raised concerns about project quality and greenwashing. JPMorgan acknowledged that earlier tokenization efforts by other firms had led to questions around double-counting and transactions involving already-retired credits. Despite these concerns, the bank said it is committed to supporting the sector. JPMorgan has previously financed carbon offset projects and purchased carbon removal credits, and has stated its ambition to be “the carbon bank of choice.” Through this latest pilot, JPMorgan is looking to show how blockchain can improve market trust and transparency in an industry still working to gain credibility. JPMorgan’s Pilot Adds Momentum to Trillion-Dollar Tokenization Push JPMorgan’s record-breaking carbon credit tokenization pilot marks another step in the broader shift toward real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, a trend projected to reshape global finance. title: Fake Japanese Bride Drains a Korean Man’s Savings via Crypto Scam
body: A Korean man in his 50s lost more than 100 million won ($73,500) after falling victim to a romance scam that leveraged cryptocurrency investments. Key Takeaways: A Korean man lost over $73,000 in a romance scam through a fake online relationship. Scammers pose as potential spouses to lure victims into fraudulent crypto exchanges. Korean authorities plan a nationwide campaign to combat crypto-related romance scams. The scheme began when the man met a woman claiming to be Japanese through a dating app in April, leading to 46 days of daily conversations that convinced him their relationship was real, according to a report from a local media outlet . Believing they were planning a future together, the woman persuaded him to invest in a cryptocurrency exchange she recommended, claiming the funds were needed to prepare for their marriage. Fear of Losing ‘Bride’ Drove Korean Man into Scam Though initially hesitant due to his lack of experience with digital assets, the man feared losing her affection and agreed to an initial investment of 200,000 won. After seeing what appeared to be quick profits and successful withdrawals, his confidence grew, leading him to invest larger sums. Over several weeks, his total investment ballooned to more than 105 million won. However, the woman soon began demanding further payments, insisting his profits were subject to a steep 5 percent daily tax. When he could no longer meet her escalating demands, she cut off contact and vanished. The Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) reportedly warned against the dangers of romance scams involving cryptocurrency, stressing that victims often hesitate to question financial requests from someone they believe is a romantic partner. Scammers commonly pose as foreigners expressing interest in marriage, later sending links to fraudulent exchanges and pressuring victims into sending money. My female friends have gotten romance scammed 6 figures and I’m like how and why it’s just crazy but yes it’s goes both ways can’t believe people fall for it — Meme Coin Calls (@memecoin_calls) July 1, 2025 Authorities reminded the public that virtual asset exchanges must register with the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit to legally operate in Korea. Many unregistered platforms are scams designed to steal deposits, and officials urged caution with any investment opportunity introduced through dating apps or social media. The FSS plans to intensify efforts against crypto-related romance scams, including a nationwide campaign in the second half of the year aimed at improving public awareness and reducing the number of victims falling prey to such schemes. Crypto Hacks, Scams Cost Investors $2.2B in H1 2025: CertiK Crypto investors lost over $2.2 billion to hacks , scams, and breaches in the first half of 2025, driven largely by wallet compromises and phishing attacks, according to CertiK’s latest security report. Wallet breaches alone caused $1.7 billion in losses across just 34 incidents, while phishing scams accounted for over $410 million across 132 attacks. Two major incidents, including Bybit’s $1.5 billion hack in February and Cetus Protocol’s $225 million exploit in May, skewed the year’s losses upward, together accounting for nearly $1.78 billion. Without these, losses align more closely with previous years at around $690 million. Ethereum remained the primary target, suffering over $1.6 billion in losses across 175 events. The report also pointed to rising sophistication of phishing schemes and ongoing risks from social engineering, urging crypto users to verify links, avoid suspicious sites, and use hardware wallets. Senate Passes Big Beautiful Bill With No Exemption For Bitcoin The United States Senate passed President Trump’s Big Beautiful Bill by a razor-thin margin after hours of heated negotiations. However, the bill brought little cheer to the crypto industry as it failed to include key crypto-related tax amendments that would have benefited the industry. Pro-crypto senators raced to include an amendment containing numerous tax benefits for crypto stakers and miners, retail digital asset users, and businesses holding crypto stockpiles. The over 1,000-page bill did not mention “digital assets,” “Bitcoin,” “Ethereum,” “crypto,” “web3,” or “blockchain” anywhere, despite efforts by pro-crypto senators to include tax breaks for the industry. Cynthia Lummis, vocal pro-crypto advocate, argued for changing the tax code for crypto mining and staking. Lummis argued that miners and stakers were being taxed twice, once when they received block rewards and again when selling their assets. “For years, miners and stakers have been taxed TWICE. Once when they receive block rewards, and again when they sell it. It’s time to stop this unfair tax treatment and ensure America is the world’s Bitcoin and Crypto Superpower.” Crypto Steady As Bitcoin (BTC) Drops To $105,000 The crypto market remained steady, registering only a marginal decline despite Bitcoin (BTC) dropping to a low of $105,328 on Tuesday. The crypto Fear & Greed Index registered a “Greed” score of 63 out of 100 on Wednesday, one point lower than Tuesday. Analysts speculate Bitcoin could retest its all-time high of $111,970, with optimism high on Monday when the price soared to an intraday high of $108,794 before losing momentum. The analysts also noted that Bitcoin is heading into its third quarter, typically a weak phase for the flagship cryptocurrency. Crypto trader Dann Crypto stated, “From the historical data, this quarter is generally the slowest out of all, for both $BTC and $ETH.” Bitcoin has averaged a gain of 5.47% during the third quarter each year since 2013. If the trend holds, it places BTC around $110,000 on Sept 30, just shy of its all-time high.
